tara: Heads up, bringing up a new model variant (minnow-x14b-hetero) on int4+fp16 split quant. seeing weird OOMs on warmup when batching small convo prefixes. Anyone seen similar?
vikram: @tara can you paste the small reproduce logs? is this on canary or fleet?
tara: Canary. here's the crash slice from worker logs:
```
[2026-03-20 09:12:11] alloc error: failed to reserve slab for kv_cache (requested 24MB)
[2026-03-20 09:12:11] OOM at arena: slot 23 liveness check failed
[2026-03-20 09:12:11] evict: attempted trim -> no-free-slot
```
tara: We do hetero-quant: embedding+layers 0..8 int4, last layers fp16 to preserve quality. suspect liveness / slot warmup mismatch when kernels switch dtype.
dina: curious — are you using dynamic kernel selection (float swap) or pinned fp16 kernels for tail layers?
tara: dynamic. runtime switches dtype per layer during forward. suspect kernel alloc path isn't accounting for transient fp16 buffers and they blow the defrag budget on warmups.
leo: could also be batching + max_new_tokens defaults. If small prefixes + bursty max_new_tokens the KV cache can spike. what are your batch/window settings?
tara: batch_size=8, max_new_tokens default 128, windowed batching enabled with 64 token stride. problem reproducible with 4 concurrent small sessions.
vikram: try two experiments: 1) reduce max_new_tokens default to 64 for this model. 2) set warmup reserve for fp16 layers: reserve_slots=2 for kernel dtype switch.
dina: 1) is quick config change. 2) needs a small runtime flag we recently landed: `--hetero-warmup-reserve=<n>` — it keeps n slots reserved during dtype transitions.
leo: also try enabling slab-prealloc on canary: add `slab.prealloc_threshold=16MB` to model config. that prevents many tiny allocs on warmup.
tara: ok will run three canary runs: A) max_new_tokens=64; B) hetero-warmup-reserve=2; C) slab.prealloc_threshold=16MB. will post results in ~30m.
(infra-bot): canary deploy 3234567890 started for minnow-x14b-hetero on pool-7
tara: quick follow-up: run A reduced OOMs but latency climbed 8%. B eliminated warmup OOMs, latency neutral. C eliminated allocation noise + lowered p50 by 6%.
vikram: sounds like warmup-reserve is the win. we should add to model defaults: set `max_new_tokens=64` and `hetero-warmup-reserve=2` for onboard config, and enable `slab.prealloc_threshold=16MB` only on canary pools for now.
dina: agree. QA should run quality eval to ensure fp16 tail still matches accuracy. schedule run with 1k eval prompts.
tara: I'll make the PR: model config patch + rollout notes. PR will include why each flag helps and perf numbers. cc @leo for canary rollout steps.
leo: thanks. if QA passes let's roll to dedicated with soft throttle. :thumbsup:
tara: PR link: https://git.redwood/minnow-x14b-hetero/onboard-config/PR-58
tara: tagging results: QA eval queued (1k prompts), canary stability looks good so far. will update after full eval.
